## 0. What changed (high level)

- NEW backend modules: industries, domainapp (contacts/catalog/records/invoices/summary),
  addons (modules+addons toggle), platform-settings (AES-256-GCM), whatsapp/sms/meta/
  google-ads (mock providers), growth-hub, communication, customer (portal).
- NEW DB tables (all `g4d_`): g4d_contacts, g4d_catalog_items, g4d_records,
  g4d_generic_invoices, g4d_vendor_addons, g4d_vendor_modules, g4d_platform_settings.
  Also: Vendor.industry now defaults to "general".
- Frontend: config-driven dashboard shell, 20 industry dashboards (dynamic route),
  AI Studio, TeleCRM 3-panel, Growth Hub, Communication Hub, Customer Portal (/customer),
  Analytics Hub, Website Manager, Admin Integrations + Vendor Access, PWA polish.

## 1. Pull latest code on the VM

```bash
cd /srv/get4domain-site        # adjust to your repo path
git fetch origin
git checkout get4domain-site
git pull origin get4domain-site
```

## 2. New environment variables (backend-api/.env.local on the VM)

REQUIRED (new):
```
# 32-byte hex master key for encrypting integration secrets at rest.
# Generate once and keep stable (rotating it makes existing encrypted values unreadable):
#   node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"
PLATFORM_SETTINGS_KEY=<paste 64-char hex here>

# Recommended so the customer portal does NOT return OTPs in API responses:
NODE_ENV=production
```

OPTIONAL (else the provider stays mocked / falls back to existing env). These can also be
set later via Admin Platform → Integrations UI (stored encrypted in g4d_platform_settings):
```
WHATSAPP_BSP_PROVIDER=      WHATSAPP_BSP_API_KEY=      WHATSAPP_BSP_ACCOUNT_ID=
META_APP_ID=  META_APP_SECRET=  META_ACCESS_TOKEN=
GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN=  GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID=  GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET=
```
Already present and reused (no change): DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL, JWT_SECRET,
RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY, CLAUDE_API_KEY, MSG91_AUTH_KEY, MSG91_SENDER_ID,
VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY/PRIVATE_KEY.

Frontend (get4domain_mvp) env: no new required vars. Uses existing NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
and NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_KEY.

## 3. Database migration (backend-api)

The migration file is NOT committed (Claude Code has no DB access to generate it safely).
Generate it once against a dev/staging DB (or with a shadow DB), commit it, then deploy:

```bash
# On a machine with access to a NON-production Postgres (or a shadow DB):
cd backend-api
npx prisma migrate dev --name v2_domainapp_core_foundation
git add prisma/migrations && git commit -m "chore(db): v2 domainapp core migration" && git push

# Then on the VM, after pulling:
cd backend-api
npx prisma migrate deploy
npx prisma generate
```
Reminder (HARD RULE): use the Supabase POOLER URL (port 6543) for DATABASE_URL.
Prisma stays 6.19.3 — do NOT upgrade.

New tables created by this migration: g4d_contacts, g4d_catalog_items, g4d_records,
g4d_generic_invoices, g4d_vendor_addons, g4d_vendor_modules, g4d_platform_settings.

## 4. Rebuild + restart containers

```bash
# Backend (CMD stays: node dist/src/main)
cd /srv/get4domain-site/backend-api
docker compose build && docker compose up -d

# Frontend
cd /srv/get4domain-site/get4domain_mvp
docker compose build && docker compose up -d
```
